mLocKeys.keySummary: Neeko slings a tangle that damages and roots everything it passes through. If the tangle kills an enemy or passes through a champion, it becomes larger, faster, and roots for longer.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Neeko slings a tangle that deals @BaseDamage@ magic damage and Roots for @MinRootDuration@ seconds.

The tangle becomes empowered after hitting an enemy, growing larger, moving faster, and Rooting for @MaxRootDuration@ seconds.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Neeko can look like an ally champion or as other units on the map. Receiving immobilizing crowd control, casting damaging spells, damaging enemy towers as a non-champion, or your disguise taking damage equal to its healthbar breaks the disguise.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Neeko can disguise herself as other units on the map. At any time she can disguise as an allied champion, or Neeko can stand next to any allied or neutral unit to store their Sho'ma and be able to transform into it. Your disguise will break upon receiving immobilizing crowd control, casting a damaging spell, damaging enemy towers as a non-champion, or your disguise taking damage equal to its healthbar.

Neeko gains many of the properties of the units she turns into, negative and positive.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Neeko throws a seed dealing magic damage. The seed blooms again on hitting champions or killing units.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Neeko throws a seed that blooms to deal <magicDamage>@ExplosionDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>. If it kills a unit or hits a champion or large monster, it will bloom again, dealing <magicDamage>@SecondDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>. Max 2 extra blooms.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Each bloom deals an additional <magicDamage>@MonsterBonus@ magic damage</magicDamage> to monsters.</rules>

mLocKeys.keySummary: After a short preparation, Neeko leaps into the air, knocking up all nearby enemies. Upon landing, nearby enemies are damaged and stunned. The preparation is hidden if Neeko is disguised.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
After a delay Neeko leaps into the air, Knocking Up all nearby enemies for @DelayUntilExplosion@ seconds. She then crashes down, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage to all nearby enemies and Stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds.

This Ability can be prepared in secret if Neeko is disguised. @DelayBeforePassiveRemoval@ seconds after casting this ability Neeko breaks her disguise.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Neeko passively deals bonus magic damage every third attack, briefly increasing her move speed. Neeko can activate to send a clone in a direction and recast to change the direction of the clone.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Every 3rd Attack deals an additional @PassiveBonusDamageCalc@ bonus magic damage and increases Neeko's Move Speed by @PassiveHaste@% for @PassiveHasteDuration@ second.

Active: Neeko becomes invisible for @StealthDuration@ seconds and projects a clone that lasts @CloneDuration@ seconds. Neeko and the clone gain @Haste@% Move Speed for @HasteDuration@ seconds.

The clone can be controlled using the Move Pet Click hotkey or by Recasting this Ability.
The clone mirrors her spellcasts, emotes, and recall.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
The clone is untargetable while stealthed.
Empowered Attacks deal @MonsterBonus@ bonus magic damage to monsters.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Neeko passively deals bonus magic damage every third attack, briefly increasing her move speed. Neeko can activate to send a clone in a direction and recast to change the direction of the clone.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Activate to command Neeko's clone to walk to target location.
Neeko's third basic attack will deal bonus magic damage.
Neeko's next basic attack will deal bonus magic damage.
